handoff: Change does what story.md asks: triage posts findings only as an issue comment and changes no file; fix/quick read the latest ## Triage comment. No blocking findings; one minor (quick review approve still cites only story.md), one nit. Suite and typecheck green.

findings.title: quick review's approve still judges only against story.md
findings.detail:
implement now reads 'story.md (the issue) and the triage findings in the issue's latest `## Triage` comment', but review's approve means 'the change does what story.md asks'. With story.md no longer holding the triage, a reviewer could treat triage-added scope (e.g. this story's fix.yaml/quick.yaml edits) as unrequested. Story: 'The decide step (and anything after it) reads the triage from the issue comment'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally say 'what story.md and the triage comment ask' in the review step's approve meaning/instructions.
